title: Finite actual-Q3 dual-state direct-D/delta-D cutoff audit
question: In the actual finite truncated Q3 regulator, does a smooth intersite coordinate cutoff have finite direct-D and full-H modular-derivative differences in both the reference Gibbs state and the local-character dual state across the declared edge and square volumes?
method: Build the registered finite Q3 Hamiltonian on the two-site edge and four-site square with oscillator dimensions 3–7 and 3–4 respectively.
Replace only bond coordinates by the declared smooth spectral cutoff at radii 0.75, 0.9 and 1.0, and form W_L=H-H_L.
Construct the local character A=exp(i*a*q_0/hbar), the reference Gibbs state rho, and the dual state rho_dual=A rho A*.
For both sigma signs and times 0.1 and 0.2, compute D_sigma and delta_H(D_sigma) and evaluate both trace legs of the reference and dual Gibbs seminorms.
Rebuild the calculation in an independent matrix implementation, compare every nested row within 1e-7 relative tolerance, and compile Lean R294 for scalar bookkeeping.
finding: Primary 245/245, independent 137/137, and integrated 1706/1706 with Lean R294 PASS. Seven finite volume/dimension rows cover two graph sizes, three stable nonzero-tail radii, two times, and both cutoff signs. All reference and dual direct-D and full-H modular-derivative seminorms are finite. The aggregate ratio range is 0.013509019647190305 to 0.705460895183117; the maximum finite dual/reference root-seminorm amplification is 1.012589605649643.
decision_reason: The actual finite regulator supplies a reproducible dual-state companion for the direct-D/delta-D diagnostic on the tested range. The result advances the QFT-facing route without proving a dual modular tail: no source/volume/beta/cutoff/exhaustion uniformity, unbounded common core, or common-alpha conclusion is inferred.

adversarial_review.check: rho_dual=A rho A* is evaluated independently from rho.
The cutoff changes only bonds and delta_H uses full H.
Both sigma signs and both seminorm trace legs are retained.
Seven finite rows do not imply an asymptotic uniform bound.
No unbounded CCR or common-core theorem is inferred.
R294 is scalar bookkeeping only; matrix exponentials remain in Python.
Common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: Finite actual-Q3 reference/dual direct-D and full-H modular-derivative cutoff rows with independent and Lean cross-checks.
qft_interface.open: Uniform dual modular tail, unbounded common core, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite dual-state direct-D/delta-D diagnostic; not a thermodynamic QFT theorem.
next_action: Prove a local modular-energy tail and direct D/delta-D integrand bound on one unbounded Q3 common core, retaining both reference and dual orientations; if uniformity fails, record the exact route obstruction.
